One valley.
Many ways of seeing.≈

A river runs through it.
So does a world.

From the upper branches around Kalam to the inhabited plains near Barikot, Swat holds many landscapes together. Forest, water, excavated stone and everyday life occupy the same valley.

This is an invitation to look beyond a single view: to follow connections between places, and to meet the sources that help us understand them.
